text: Server admin gets its own entry in the main menu, out of user settings

Landed in 25e5601: a Server admin entry after Settings in both main menus, admin-only, with the entry removed from both settings screens. Android got isAdmin from the LoginViewModel the drawer already uses (sessionState.isAdmin) rather than a new injection point, so the drawer tests keep using FakeSessionState. A comment on both clients says hiding the entry is an affordance and the server still enforces admin on every /admin route. No new string: the web twin moved key from settings.serverAdmin to nav.serverAdmin, and the two keys the change orphaned (settings.openServerAdmin, admin.backToSettings) were pruned from all nine catalogs per the en.ts rule. Mutation-checked on both clients. Gate green: server 504, web 411, Android.
